title: Claude vs. Other Chatbots
description: Understand how Claude compares to ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI assistants so you can choose the right tool for each task.

data.text: In 2025, four AI assistants dominate everyday knowledge work: ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), and Perplexity. Each is built on large language models, but they differ in where they excel, their context windows, how they handle long content, and how they integrate with other tools. Understanding these differences helps you avoid the common mistake of using the wrong tool for a task.

data.title: Where Claude stands out:
items: 200K token context window — the largest usable context among mainstream assistants
Exceptionally careful and nuanced writing style
Excellent at reading and analyzing very long documents
Clean, readable code generation across many languages

cards.title: Claude (Anthropic)
cards.description: Built for careful, thoughtful assistance with a focus on safety and honesty. The 200K context window is its defining feature.
cons: Limited web browsing in free tier

cards.title: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
cards.description: The most versatile general-purpose assistant. Excellent free tier with broad capabilities and a massive plugin ecosystem.
cons: Can be verbose without careful prompting

cards.title: Gemini (Google)
cards.description: Google's native AI assistant with deep integration into Workspace. The Pro version offers a massive 1M token context.

rows: Best context retention and precise edits

data.title: Switch to Claude when:
items: You are working with a very long document (book, legal brief, codebase)
You need careful, nuanced writing that stays precisely on-brief
ChatGPT loses track of earlier instructions in a long conversation
You want the AI to resist improvising beyond what you asked for
You are evaluating, editing, or fact-checking long content

data.text: When Claude Is Not the Best Choice

data.title: Consider other tools when:
items: You need image generation — use ChatGPT or Midjourney
You work primarily inside Google Workspace — use Gemini
You need cited sources for factual claims — use Perplexity
You want to run code directly in the chat — use ChatGPT Code Interpreter
You are on a tight budget and want the best free tier — compare current offerings

data.title: The multi-model workflow
data.text: Experienced AI users rarely rely on a single model. They route different stages to the best tool: Perplexity for research, Claude for long-document synthesis, ChatGPT for drafting, Gemini for final delivery into Google Workspace.

data.title: Key takeaways
points: Claude's biggest advantage is its 200K context window and careful writing style
No single model is best at everything — build the reflex to choose based on task
ChatGPT remains the best generalist for everyday use
Gemini wins when your work lives inside Google products
Perplexity is the right choice for sourced factual research
